audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed with the packet, and every one of them also disagreed with the whys[] line printed beside it.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Tryndamere/Skill/Skill/Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Skill, and whys[0] 'Level 1 is yours', whys[1] and whys[2] 'skill-based', whys[3] and whys[4] 'yours', whys[6] 'skill-based' match it exactly. The stored sides were simply offset.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 realigned in both layers as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere, including for the ultimate the entire page is keyed to.
audit.why: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140/115/90s and Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s — both far longer than your Spinning Slash at 12s, which is what makes 'fight on her cooldown' a real plan rather than a slogan.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and spikes[1].text carry the 140s ultimate; spikes[0].text and dontsFull[1].d carry Hookshot's 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text said 'her E and W shield are spent'. Camille's shield is Adaptive Defenses, her passive, procced by attacking a champion — Tactical Sweep (W) is a cone that slows and HEALS her on the outer half.
audit.why: Waiting for a 'W shield' to be on cooldown is waiting for something that has no cooldown to wait out; the real reads are the passive proc and the W heal, which is what Grievous Wounds is for.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text names Adaptive Defenses as the shield; spikes[0].text states Tactical Sweep's outer-half heal.

audit.why: Precision Protocol's recast true damage is already stated in spikes[2] and wants.foe[0], matching the mirror's finding that the true damage sits on Q and not on Tactical Sweep. Hookshot's wall requirement is correctly reflected in wants.you[2]. The Hextech Ultimatum anchors rather than silences — 'isolation' is accurate.

edits.before: Skill-based mid-window: Camille's Q Precision Protocol double-hit and E Hookshot wall-dash let her burst-trade and disengage. Punish her when E is down, and don't stand next to walls where her Hookshot stun lands cleanly.
edits.after: Skill-based mid-window: Precision Protocol's delayed recast hits for true damage, and Hookshot is a 16s wall-dash knock-up. Punish while it is down, stay off walls, and remember Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her.

edits.before: Your R Undying Rage beats her R Hextech Ultimatum isolation. When she ults to lock you 1v1, pop Undying Rage, ride out her Q burst, and crit-Q back up while her E and W shield are spent.
edits.after: Undying Rage beats The Hextech Ultimatum's anchor, and hers is 140s at rank 1. Pop R, ride out the Q true damage, and crit-Q back up — the shield refilling her is Adaptive Defenses, not her W.

edits.before: Her 1v1 isolation. R survives it; out-crit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
